newsitem.title: FRANCE: Venezuela to apply privatisation revenues to fund.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela to apply privatisation revenues to fund.

text.p: Venezuelan Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos-Azocar said on Friday the government expected to earmark some privatisation proceeds for a stabilisation fund aimed at reducing Venezuela's vulnerability to oil shocks.

The fund will be capitalised from two sources, "one using proceeds from the privatisations -- to give an idea, if we privatise as scheduled Alucasa...some $3.5 billion would go into the fund," he told a news conference in Paris. "So it wouldn't depend just on oil (revenue)," he said.

Matos-Azocar also said the government expected to privatise two banks this year, Banco Latino and the smaller Banco Republica. He did not offer an estimate for the total revenue from the privatisations.
He said the amount had not been publicly disclosed and added that it would depend on the offers and final sale prices.
The government of Venezuela said last month that it planned to privatise aluminium firm Alucasa at the beginning of 1997.
Earlier this month, the cabinet approved the creation of a fund designed to buffer the oil-rich country in times of low international oil prices.
